coordinate_system.domain: two-node effective spin graph without spatial coordinates
coordinate_system.hardware: not_applicable; effective spin sites are not neutral-atom positions

reference.method: exact diagonalization of the request-resolved packaged Pauli Hamiltonian

allowed_claims: Compare CASCAQit VQE with exact diagonalization of the same effective spin Hamiltonian.
Explain exchange coupling, local fields, Pauli observables, and spin-correlation measurements.
limitations: This is a two-spin low-energy effective model, not a full metal-enzyme electronic-structure calculation.
Model context nodes are not electronic orbitals and are not a neutral-atom hardware layout.
The experiment does not predict catalytic barriers, reaction rates, redox potentials, or enzyme activity.
Local simulation only; no hardware execution or quantum advantage claim.
